historical_scope: Thirty completed original launch requests, numbers 124 through 224 across four historical parameter families. Original scientific outputs, partials, timeouts, missing responses, rules interruptions, readback and compilation failures, and successes are preserved with their full original result documents and actual official job conclusions.
historical_proof: Each request has the identical byte count and Git blob in its own official scientific source commit and the declared before_commit. Each listed compute and report job has a terminal status. The control and scientific executable or full native source generator are preserved and checked against the corresponding complete historical parameter file.
reproduction: From the topic, run node computations/reproduce_ret100l_controls_native_and_current_c_parameters.mjs <output-directory>. Five independently retained original inputs are read from the identified Git tree. The seven complete semantic edit sets reconstruct entire requests in order. Four targets require a total of twelve original numeric token spellings, each recorded with its token position and original lexeme. Restore writes the original indentation and terminal newline, verifying bytes, SHA-256 and Git identity for every request. Each complete request is separately retained in the original immutable run tree.
